title: Kestrel Care Rewards Benefit Notice: Club Generic Discount for Platinum and Gold Members — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Kestrel Care Rewards levels carry a benefit on the Kestrel Rx Savings Club price of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. The generic discount percentage a club price starts from depends on the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards level and on the prescription pickups the fill ledger shows dated fewer than 12 whole months before today:

- a **Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum** member with **10 or more** such pickups gets **35 percent**;
- a **Kestrel Care Rewards Gold** member with **6 or more** such pickups gets **30 percent**;
- every other patient gets the program's generic discount percentage.

The benefit concerns the club price of a generic fill sold for cash that is not on the Kestrel Value Generics list; it does not apply to a brand fill. The level is the level of the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status, and the pickups are the pickup entries on the patient's Prescriptions fill ledger.

## Both parts of the condition

| Rewards level | Pickups in the last 12 whole months | Generic discount percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 10 or more | 35 percent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 9 or fewer | the program's generic discount percentage |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 6 or more | 30 percent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 5 or fewer | the program's generic discount percentage |
| Any other level, or no active membership | any number | the program's generic discount percentage |

## Counting the pickups

A pickup counts when it is dated fewer than 12 whole months before today. *Hypothetical:* a pickup dated exactly 12 whole months before today does not count; one dated a day later does.

## Hypothetical members

- A Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum member with 10 pickups in the window: 35 percent.
- A Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum member with 7 pickups in the window: 7 is below 10, and the 30 percent band belongs to Gold members, so the program's generic discount percentage.
- A Kestrel Care Rewards Gold member with 6 pickups: 30 percent.
